recentDiary.text: Rested for a bit. Not tired. I feel fine. Don't know what to do next.
Listened outside. Crickets sounding. Heard them before. I feel good. Still curious.
Walked around town again. Saw nothing new. Bored more than before. Not tired.
Feel fine. Not tired, really. Went to sleep anyway. Will wake up on my own.
